title: Implement safe AgentOS soft-update staging, activation, and rollback
goal: Build a fail-closed AgentOS soft-update pipeline that fetches bounded text definitions read-only from GitHub, verifies integrity and local base hashes, stages separately, activates transactionally with a durable snapshot, and exposes it in Settings.
context: Issue #432 covers read-only GitHub transport, isolated staging, revalidation, durable snapshot, activation, rollback, and Settings UI. Native executable code remains out of scope.
forbidden_changes: Do not load or execute downloaded native code.
Do not change Xcode project, entitlements, provider credentials, or unrelated modules.
Do not push to GitHub or mutate the active workspace during fetch/staging.
Activation must snapshot first, re-check base hashes, and restore the snapshot if any write fails.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest and paths are validated; only bounded Markdown, JSON, and text files in approved AgentOS roots are accepted.
Remote Git blob integrity, SHA-256 content hashes, byte counts, repository/base revision, and local base hashes are checked.
Files are staged separately and active workspace remains unchanged until explicit activation.
Activation revalidates local content, creates a durable snapshot, and rolls back on any partial failure.
Settings exposes check/stage, activate, and rollback actions; no native code is loaded.
Regression tests cover SHA-256 known vector, traversal, executable files, manifest round-trip, and safe-path boundaries.
verification: Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI results
recovery: Revert this single logical commit if package compilation, contract validation, or staging-boundary tests regress.
